text: This report provides the Board of Health with an update on the risk management reporting that is part of the Ontario Public Health Standards Accountability Framework. It outlines risks and challenges facing Toronto Public Health in 2024, which include talent availability, resource capacity to address evolving and emerging public health issues, and challenges securing public support and adherence to public health advice.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (June 20, 2024) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
